title: WeXel oder Die Musik einer Landschaft Teil 2.1 - Das Weltliche Lied - Ungeradtaktig: Jodler und Jodler-Lied – Ungeradtaktig
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Yodel and Yodel-Song in the Lower Austrian / Styrian Wechsel region from the beginning of the 19th century, completed with local research 2001–2019 (especially Schwaigen-Reigen® 2007–2009 – traditional music in 18 alpine huts at the beginning of the alpine pasture in June) and references to other sources. Landscape and social structure of the Lower Austrian / Styrian Wechsel-region: once turnstile of the Austro-Hungarian member-states, today centre of the European Union. For the first time a conscious differentiation between measures in triple metre (3/4) and duple metre (2/4) both with yodels and yodel-songs, thus showing its stylistic influence.
